rows.coder_note: Cited to Sun 2023 (ref 28, DOI of four dictionary rows) with 54,219 participants and 2,940 proteins; 54,219 is the sample size of none of the four rows and no ancestry or subcohort is stated, so no attribute separates them (rule E not met).

rows.quote: The deCODE study involved 35,559 Icelanders with a mean age of 55 years and measured the 4,667 unique plasma protein levels of 4,907 aptamers [29], as detailed in S4 Table.
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, Sveinbjornsson G, Magnusson MI, Styrmisdottir EL, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet. 2021;53(12):1712–21. doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the deCODE data to ref 29, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is that of the Ferkingstad 2021 row alone; the sentence also gives that row's exact N 35,559 and 4,907 aptamers; Table 1 (PMID 34857953) and the data statement agree.
